description: This file defines the ClaimEventDecorator class which encapsulates a ClaimEvent object and provides methods to interact with it, including setting the associated user based on user ID. It acts as a decorator pattern implementation for ClaimEvent entities within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: ClaimEventDecorator
classes.description: Decorator class for ClaimEvent entity to add context-specific methods and integration logic.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with a ClaimEvent instance.

methods.name: setUserByUserId
methods.description: Sets the user associated with the ClaimEvent based on a user ID.
